name: Marketing 360
description_en:
Marketing 360 combines business software with marketing services for small businesses. Its Nurture offering places email and text messaging alongside CRM, forms, websites and other tools. For automation research, the concrete workflow is an email journey fed by a selected Email List, often populated through CRM rules.

The platform’s broad service promise is not the same as every trigger being available in one universal workflow engine. Official guides distinguish CRM Contacts, CRM Lists, Email Lists and list-contained segments. They also contain unresolved repeat-trigger statements. This profile traces those data handoffs and the documented evaluation paths without claiming an account test or a confirmed commercial package.
description_zh:
Marketing 360 将商业软件与面向小企业的营销服务结合。其 Nurture 将邮件及短信消息放在 CRM、表单、网站及其他工具旁。对于自动化研究，具体流程是一条使用指定 Email List 的邮件旅程，该列表通常由 CRM 规则填充。

平台广泛的服务承诺，不代表每种入口都在一个通用工作流引擎中可用。官方指南区分 CRM Contacts、CRM Lists、Email Lists 及列表内分群，也包含尚未解决的重复触发说法。本文追踪这些数据交接及文档评估路径，不声称进行过账户测试或确认商业套餐。

core_features.explanation_en: An assigned CRM list can populate the Email List used by a journey.
core_features.explanation_zh: 已分配 CRM 列表可填充旅程使用的 Email List。

core_features.explanation_en: Segments use subscriber fields and tracked activity within one Email List.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分群使用单一 Email List 内的订阅者字段及跟踪行为。

core_features.explanation_en: Submission rules can classify incoming contacts for list assignment.
core_features.explanation_zh: 提交规则可为入站联系人分类以分配列表。

core_features.explanation_en: Insights separates automated journey metrics from campaign reporting.
core_features.explanation_zh: Insights 将自动旅程指标与群发活动报告区分。

en: Editorial fit: a small service business coordinating CRM leads, forms and email follow-up.
Editorial fit: a team evaluating business software alongside managed marketing services.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：协调 CRM 线索、表单及邮件跟进的小型服务企业。
编辑判断的适用场景：共同评估商业软件及托管营销服务的团队。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Trace one source’s new and duplicate submission rules into the intended CRM list.
steps.zh: 追踪一个来源的新提交及重复规则至目标 CRM 列表。

steps.en: Choose list connection order based on whether existing contacts should enter.
steps.zh: 按是否希望已有联系人加入选择列表连接顺序。

steps.en: Test one qualified internal contact and inspect recipient activity.
steps.zh: 测试一个合格内部联系人并检查收件人活动。

steps.en: Confirm current package, usage allowances and recurring-entry behavior.
steps.zh: 确认当前套餐、用量额度及重复加入行为。

items.en: The migrated trigger guide contains incompatible repetition statements; reliable repeat-entry settings are not confirmed.
items.zh: 迁移后的入口指南包含不兼容重复说法，未确认可靠的重复加入设置。

items.en: Missing activity tracking is not the same as observed non-engagement; segment inclusion can be affected.
items.zh: 缺少行为跟踪不等于已观察到不互动，可能影响分群加入。

items.en: Pause/resume clocks, retries, message recall and exact Condition-step behavior remain unverified.
items.zh: 暂停／恢复时钟、重试、消息撤回及 Condition 步骤确切行为仍未核实。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: No current package dollar amount was established. The current product page links to Get Plans & Pricing; that destination repeatedly timed out in the web reader and an ordinary TLS-verified HTTPS request. The actual hosting-price-update guide describes renewal/bundling mechanisms only, not a universal app price. Confirm services, advertising spend, messaging allowances, term and cancellation in the actual offer. Free-report/trial wording does not establish sustained free software; no normalized price assigned.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 未确认当前套餐金额。当前产品页链接 Get Plans & Pricing，但该目标在网页读取器及普通 TLS 校验 HTTPS 请求中多次超时。实读托管调价指南仅说明续费／组合机制，并非通用应用价格。应在真实优惠中确认服务、广告预算、消息额度、期限及取消条件。免费报告／试用文案不能确认持续免费软件，不生成标准化价格。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: A form needs the full CRM-to-email path
sections.title_zh: 表单需要完整的 CRM 到邮件路径
sections.en: The form/order guide treats orders as form submissions: connect a source, configure submission and duplicate rules, create a CRM list and assign it to an Email List, then build the journey against that list. For an editorial service-enquiry pilot, give a test submission an explicit type/status/tag and inspect each handoff. This path is different from assuming an arbitrary commerce purchase event directly triggers a journey; the trigger guide restricts its direct store trigger to Shopify.
sections.zh: 表单／订单指南把订单作为表单提交处理：连接来源，配置提交及重复规则，创建 CRM 列表并分配至 Email List，再基于该列表建立旅程。编辑示例：服务咨询试点可为测试提交明确 type／status／tag，逐个检查交接。这不同于假设任意商业购买事件都能直接触发旅程；入口指南将直接商店入口限定于 Shopify。

sections.title_en: A repeat enquiry can update different fields differently
sections.title_zh: 重复咨询可能以不同方式更新字段
sections.en: Source settings can enable updates for repeated submissions, append or replace contact type/status/assignee, and add or replace tags. Mapped fields have a separate overwrite option; otherwise the guide says only a history item is created and possible field changes are ignored. Test an existing internal contact with a changed enquiry category as well as a new contact. A form arriving successfully does not establish that the list-driving field changed in the way the journey requires.
sections.zh: 来源设置可启用重复提交更新，对联系人类型／状态／负责人追加或替换，并添加或替换标签。映射字段另有覆盖选项；否则指南说只创建历史条目，可能的字段变化会被忽略。应测试更换咨询类别的已有内部联系人，以及新联系人。表单成功到达，不能证明驱动列表的字段已按旅程要求变化。

sections.title_en: Existing CRM contacts require deliberate admission
sections.title_zh: 已有 CRM 联系人需要明确加入安排
sections.en: For selected existing contacts, the dedicated guide creates an empty Email List, builds and activates its journey, then assigns a newly configured CRM list to it. The troubleshooting guide describes the opposite connection order when existing contacts should be excluded. These sequences make activation order part of audience selection. For a pilot, record the before/after contact counts and intended cohort before connecting the lists; a populated CRM alone is not evidence that the audience entered.
sections.zh: 针对选定已有联系人，专门指南先创建空 Email List，建立并启用旅程，再分配新配置的 CRM 列表。排障指南则在希望排除已有联系人时描述相反连接顺序。因此启用顺序也是受众选择的一部分。试点应在连接列表前记录前后人数及目标群体；CRM 已有联系人不证明受众已加入。

sections.title_en: Entry membership does not continuously govern every email
sections.title_zh: 加入时的成员身份不会持续约束每封邮件
sections.en: Segments are confined to their list. Missing tracked activity can be indistinguishable from inactivity, so an engagement-based segment needs a tracking check. The trigger guide says people continue a segment-triggered journey even if membership changes; its documented workaround applies the same segment separately to each email for a send-time check. It also contradicts itself on repeat frequency, offering repeated entry but later asserting once per address. Verify the account’s actual options and repeated-membership behavior before promising a recurring program.
sections.zh: 分群局限于所属列表。缺少跟踪行为可能与不活跃无法区分，因此互动分群需要检查跟踪。入口指南说成员身份变化后仍会继续分群旅程；文档方案是在每封邮件单独选择同一分群以在发送时检查。它对重复频率也自相矛盾，一处提供重复加入，后文却断言每地址仅一次。承诺重复活动前，应验证账户实际选项及重复成员变化行为。

sections.title_en: Historical audiences have specific, consequential methods
sections.title_zh: 历史受众有具体且会产生实际影响的方法
sections.en: The existing-email-list guide provides distinct list removal/re-addition, initially empty segment and future-date methods. The first has an explicit Add new subscribers to the related journey checkbox; it is not proof that an ordinary import always enrolls people. The date method starts at midnight and adds a delay to reach a later hour. As editorial guidance, prefer evaluating a narrowly selected internal cohort and preserving existing membership before any broad recovery operation. No deletion, re-import or mass enrollment was carried out here.
sections.zh: 已有邮件列表指南提供移出后重新加入、初始空分群、未来日期三种不同方法。第一种包含明确的 Add new subscribers to the related journey 复选框，不能据此认为普通导入总会加入旅程。日期方法从午夜开始，再增加延迟以到达较晚时刻。编辑建议是在广泛恢复操作前先评估小范围内部群体并保留已有成员关系。本次未删除、重新导入或批量加入。

sections.title_en: A template test is different from a qualified journey test
sections.title_zh: 模板测试不同于符合入口资格的旅程测试
sections.en: The builder requires completed steps before Turn on journey becomes available. Its Condition row repeats the Email description, so exact branching behavior is not established by that table. For an end-to-end test, the troubleshooting guide calls for a genuinely new CRM contact meeting the assigned list criteria; directly adding an address to the Email List does not reproduce that path. Inspect Recipient Activity and the subscriber profile as well as the inbox. A preview alone does not validate list linkage or admission.
sections.zh: 创建器要求完成步骤后才可 Turn on journey。其 Condition 行重复 Email 描述，因此不能据该表确认准确分支行为。端到端测试方面，排障指南要求真正的新 CRM 联系人符合已分配列表条件；直接向 Email List 添加地址不能复现该路径。应同时检查 Recipient Activity、订阅者档案及收件箱。仅预览不能验证列表关联或加入。

sections.title_en: An active-journey metric counts sending journeys
sections.title_zh: 活动旅程指标统计实际发信的旅程
sections.en: Insights updates campaign/journey data hourly and subscriber details daily, with reports reaching back up to 15 months. Its Active journeys metric includes active journeys that sent during the chosen period, rather than every enabled journey. A changed CTA or link in a new journey-email version creates a new reporting row. Compare the same date range and link version, and inspect individual activity before treating a missing aggregate count as a failed trigger. Documented delivered counts subtract bounces; they do not establish inbox placement.
sections.zh: Insights 每小时更新活动／旅程数据，每日更新订阅者详情，报告可回看最多 15 个月。Active journeys 指标统计所选期间实际发信的活动旅程，并非所有已启用旅程。旅程邮件新版本修改 CTA 或链接会生成新报告行。应比较相同时间范围和链接版本，先检查个人活动，再将汇总缺失视为入口失败。文档投递数扣除退信，不能确认收件箱位置。

sections.title_en: Scope the software and services together
sections.title_zh: 共同确认软件与服务范围
sections.en: The current Nurture page links messaging to CRM and a broader package of business tools and dedicated marketing services. A hosting-price update guide discusses renewal changes and possible app bundling, but does not establish today’s complete package price. An evaluation should obtain the actual software, service, messaging-usage and advertising-budget scope before comparing total cost with a standalone email product. No sales form was submitted, and the current plans page repeatedly timed out.
sections.zh: 当前 Nurture 页将消息与 CRM、商业工具及专属营销服务组合关联。托管调价指南讨论续费变化及可能的应用组合，但不能确认今天完整套餐价格。评估应取得真实的软件、服务、消息用量及广告预算范围，再与独立邮件产品比较总成本。本次未提交销售表单，当前套餐页多次超时。

seo.title_en: Marketing 360: CRM email journeys, list linkage and trigger limits
seo.title_zh: Marketing 360：CRM 邮件旅程、列表关联与入口边界
seo.description_en: Research Marketing 360 form-to-CRM email automation, existing contacts, segment eligibility, journey reporting and commercial scope.
seo.description_zh: 研究 Marketing 360 表单到 CRM 邮件自动化、已有联系人、分群资格、旅程报告及商业范围。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Marketing 360 CRM-driven email journeys and managed-marketing fit
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: No account, form, message, list reassignment, import, deletion or sales inquiry was operated.
research_gaps.zh: 未操作账户、表单、消息、列表重分配、导入、删除或销售咨询。

research_gaps.en: Current plans/pricing destination timed out; exact fees, allowances, contract and sustained-free entitlement remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 当前套餐／价格目标超时；确切费用、额度、合同及持续免费权限仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: Repeat triggers, pause clocks, delivery recovery, current UI languages, regional eligibility and self-hosting rights remain unresolved.
research_gaps.zh: 重复入口、暂停时钟、投递恢复、当前界面语言、地区资格及自托管权利仍未解决。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
